958	/-- **Basic-open restriction localizes, for a sheaf in the essential image of `tilde`.**
959	
960	For a sheaf of modules `M` on `Spec R` whose tilde-Gamma counit `M.fromTildeΓ` is an
961	isomorphism (equivalently, `M` lies in the essential image of the `tilde` functor — the
962	honest Spec-affine stand-in for quasi-coherence, see the section header), the presheaf
963	restriction map of `M` from global sections `Γ(M, ⊤)` to the basic open `Γ(M, D(f))`
964	exhibits the latter as `IsLocalizedModule (powers f)` over `R`.
965	
966	This transports `isLocalizedModule_tilde_restrict` across the isomorphism
967	`M.fromTildeΓ : tilde N ⟶ M` (where `N = Γ(M, ⊤)`): the induced presheaf isomorphism is
968	natural in the open, so on each of `⊤` and `D(f)` it provides an `R`-linear isomorphism
969	intertwining the two restriction maps. Post- and pre-composing the localization map for
970	`tilde N` with these isomorphisms (`IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv`,
971	`IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right`) yields the property for `M`.
972	
973	Project-local: it is the affine engine of `lem:qcoh_section_localization_basicOpen`. The
974	general quasi-coherent case additionally requires the (currently Mathlib-absent) bridge
975	`IsQuasicoherent M → IsIso M.fromTildeΓ`. -/
976	theorem isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
977	    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [IsIso M.fromTildeΓ] (f : R) :
978	    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
979	      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
980	        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom := by
981	  -- the presheaf-level isomorphism induced by the (iso) counit `M.fromTildeΓ`
982	  let ψ := (TopCat.Sheaf.forget (ModuleCat R) (Spec R)).map (modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ)
983	  haveI : IsIso ψ := inferInstance
984	  haveI : IsIso (ψ.app (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) := inferInstance
985	  haveI : IsIso (ψ.app (.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))) := inferInstance
986	  -- the component isomorphisms as `R`-linear equivalences
987	  let eTop : _ ≃ₗ[R] _ := (asIso (ψ.app (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)))).toLinearEquiv
988	  let eDf : _ ≃ₗ[R] _ := (asIso (ψ.app (.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)))).toLinearEquiv
989	  -- the restriction map of `tilde N` (localizes by `isLocalizedModule_tilde_restrict`)
990	  let rt := ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
991	        (tilde ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)))).presheaf.map
992	        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
993	  -- naturality square of `ψ` for `D(f) ⟶ ⊤`
994	  have hnat := ψ.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op
995	  have hnathom := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hnat
996	  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hnathom
997	  haveI hrt : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) rt :=
998	    isLocalizedModule_tilde_restrict ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) f
999	  haveI step1 : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (eDf.toLinearMap ∘ₗ rt) :=
1000	    IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv (S := Submonoid.powers f) (f := rt) (e := eDf)
1001	  haveI step2 : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
1002	      ((eDf.toLinearMap ∘ₗ rt) ∘ₗ eTop.symm.toLinearMap) :=
1003	    IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right (S := Submonoid.powers f)
1004	      (f := eDf.toLinearMap ∘ₗ rt) (e := eTop.symm)
1005	  -- identify the target restriction map with `(eDf ∘ rt) ∘ eTop⁻¹`
1006	  convert step2 using 1 <;> try rfl
1007	  refine heq_of_eq ?_
1008	  apply LinearMap.ext; intro x
1009	  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun hnathom (eTop.symm x)
1010	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hc ⊢
1011	  refine (?_ : _ = _).trans hc.symm
1012	  congr 1
1013	  exact (eTop.apply_symm_apply x).symm

1015	/-- A morphism of sheaves of `R`-modules on `Spec R` that is an isomorphism on every basic open
1016	`D(f)` is an isomorphism. This is the "isomorphism on a basis ⟹ isomorphism" reduction specialised
1017	to the basic-open basis of `Spec R` (`PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens`): injectivity on stalks is
1018	`stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis`, surjectivity on stalks is the basic-open germ lift, and
1019	`isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso` concludes. Project-local glue used to assemble `IsIso M.fromTildeΓ`
1020	from per-basic-open section data. -/

1022	    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf (ModuleCat.{u} R) (Spec R)} (α : F ⟶ G)
1023	    (h : ∀ f : R, IsIso (α.1.app (.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)))) : IsIso α := by
1024	  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis (Set.range (@PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen R _)) :=
1025	    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens
1026	  have hinj : ∀ U ∈ Set.range (@PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen R _),
1027	      Function.Injective (α.1.app (.op U)) := by
1028	    rintro U ⟨f, rfl⟩
1029	    exact ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp (h f)).1
1030	  have hstalk : ∀ x, IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) x).map α.1) := by
1031	    intro x
1032	    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
1033	    refine ⟨TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis hB hinj x, ?_⟩
1034	    intro t
1035	    obtain ⟨U, hxU, hUB, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis hB G.presheaf x t
1036	    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hUB
1037	    obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ := ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp (h f)).2 s
1038	    exact ⟨F.presheaf.germ _ x hxU s', by rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]⟩
1039	  exact TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso α

1041	/-- A linear map intertwining two localizations of the same module at the same submonoid is
1042	bijective: if `f : M →ₗ M'` and `g : M →ₗ M''` both exhibit a localization at `S` and
1043	`h : M' →ₗ M''` satisfies `h ∘ₗ f = g`, then `h` is bijective (it is the canonical localization
1044	isomorphism `IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv`). Stated with the two `IsLocalizedModule` facts as
1045	explicit hypotheses to avoid typeclass-diamond ambiguity at the call site. -/
1046	private theorem bijective_comp_of_localizations {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (S : Submonoid R)
1047	    {M M' M'' : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
1048	    [AddCommGroup M''] [Module R M''] {f : M →ₗ[R] M'} {g : M →ₗ[R] M''} {h : M' →ₗ[R] M''}
1049	    (hf : IsLocalizedModule S f) (hg : IsLocalizedModule S g) (hh : h ∘ₗ f = g) :
1050	    Function.Bijective h := by
1051	  haveI := hf; haveI := hg
1052	  have heq : h = (IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv S f g).toLinearMap := by
1053	    apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext S (f := f) (f' := g)
1054	    apply LinearMap.ext
1055	    intro x
1056	    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, hh,
1057	      LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv_apply]
1058	  rw [heq]
1059	  exact (IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv S f g).bijective

1061	/-- **`IsIso M.fromTildeΓ` from per-basic-open section localization** (the cheap stalk/section
1062	assembly of `lem:qcoh_affine_isIso_fromTildeΓ`, the blueprint "G1-assemble" step). If for every
1063	`f : R` the section restriction `Γ(M, ⊤) → Γ(M, D(f))` of a sheaf of modules `M` on `Spec R`
1064	exhibits the target as `IsLocalizedModule (powers f)` over `R` — exactly the conclusion of G1-core
1065	(`lem:qcoh_affine_section_localization`,
1066	`isLocalizedModule_basicOpen_of_isQuasicoherent`) — then the tilde-Gamma counit `M.fromTildeΓ` is
1067	an isomorphism (equivalently `M` lies in the essential image of `tilde`).
1068	
1069	On each basic open `D(f)` the component of `modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ` is a map between
1070	two localizations of `N = Γ(M, ⊤)` at `powers f`: the source `Γ(tilde N, D(f))` localizes via the
1071	instance `tilde.toOpen N (D f)` and the target `Γ(M, D(f))` localizes by hypothesis, and the two
1072	localization maps are intertwined by `Scheme.Modules.toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app`. Hence the component is
1073	the canonical localization isomorphism (`IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv`);
1074	`isIso_sheaf_of_isIso_app_basicOpen` upgrades this to an isomorphism of sheaves, and
1075	`modulesSpecToSheaf` being fully faithful reflects it to `IsIso M.fromTildeΓ`.
1076	
1077	This turns the remaining keystone obligation into exactly G1-core: combined with the converse engine
1078	`isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ`, the per-basic-open localization hypothesis is
1079	*equivalent* to `IsIso M.fromTildeΓ`. Project-local: Mathlib has no `IsQuasicoherent → IsIso
1080	fromTildeΓ` bridge. -/
1081	theorem isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isLocalizedModule_restrict {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
1082	    (M : (Spec R).Modules)
1083	    (H : ∀ f : R, IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
1084	      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
1085	        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom) :
1086	    IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := by
1087	  haveI hmain : IsIso (modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ) := by
1088	    apply isIso_sheaf_of_isIso_app_basicOpen
1089	    intro f
1090	    set N := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤) with hN
1091	    -- target localizes by hypothesis; source localizes by the `tilde.toOpen` instance
1092	    haveI htgt : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
1093	        ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
1094	          (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom := H f
1095	    set comp := (modulesSpecToSheaf.map M.fromTildeΓ).1.app (.op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
1096	      with hcomp
1097	    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
1098	    have hcompose := Scheme.Modules.toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
1099	    -- the component intertwines the two localization maps of `N` at `powers f`

1101	        = ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
1102	          (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom := by
1103	      have e := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hcompose
1104	      rwa [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at e
1105	    change Function.Bijective (⇑comp.hom)
1106	    exact bijective_comp_of_localizations (Submonoid.powers f)
1107	      (inferInstance : IsLocalizedModule _ (tilde.toOpen N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)).hom)

1111	/-- **Characterization of `IsIso M.fromTildeΓ` by section localization.** For a sheaf of modules
1112	`M` on `Spec R`, the tilde-Gamma counit `M.fromTildeΓ` is an isomorphism iff for every `f : R` the
1113	section restriction `Γ(M, ⊤) → Γ(M, D(f))` exhibits the target as `IsLocalizedModule (powers f)`.
1114	
1115	The forward direction is the affine engine `isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ`; the
1116	reverse is `isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isLocalizedModule_restrict`. Combined with G1-core
1117	(`isLocalizedModule_basicOpen_of_isQuasicoherent`, `lem:qcoh_affine_section_localization`, not yet
1118	formalized) — which supplies the right-hand side for any quasi-coherent `M` — this yields gap1
1119	(`lem:qcoh_affine_isIso_fromTildeΓ`). Project-local. -/
1120	theorem isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizedModule_restrict {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
1121	    (M : (Spec R).Modules) :
1122	    IsIso M.fromTildeΓ ↔ ∀ f : R, IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
1123	      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
1124	        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom :=
1125	  ⟨fun h f => by haveI := h; exact isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ M f,
1126	    isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isLocalizedModule_restrict M⟩

1128	/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — G1-core (Route F) building blocks
1129	
1130	The keystone G1-core `lem:qcoh_affine_section_localization` asks: for a *quasi-coherent*
1131	`M : (Spec R).Modules` and `f : R`, the section restriction `Γ(M,⊤) → Γ(M,D(f))` is
1132	`IsLocalizedModule (powers f)`. Via `isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizedModule_restrict` this is
1133	*equivalent* to `IsIso M.fromTildeΓ` — i.e. to the statement that a quasi-coherent sheaf on an
1134	affine scheme lies in the essential image of `tilde` (the `QCoh(Spec R) ≃ Mod R` equivalence). That
1135	equivalence is a genuine Mathlib gap at the pinned commit (Tilde.lean only proves the *globally
1136	presented* case, `isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_presentation`).
1137	
1138	The composition lemma below discharges the **globally-presented** sub-case end to end (it is the
1139	Route-F endpoint once a global presentation/tilde identification is in hand). The residual gap is
1140	exactly the production of a global presentation/tilde from local (quasi-coherent) data on `Spec R`;
1141	see the handoff in `task_results/.../QuotScheme.md`. -/
1142	
1143	/-- **Basic-open restriction localizes, for a globally presented module.** If `M : (Spec R).Modules`
1144	admits a global `SheafOfModules.Presentation`, then for every `f : R` the section restriction
1145	`Γ(M,⊤) → Γ(M,D(f))` exhibits the target as `IsLocalizedModule (powers f)` over `R`.
1146	
1147	This is the composition of Mathlib's `isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_presentation` (a global presentation
1148	forces `M.fromTildeΓ` to be an isomorphism, i.e. `M` is a `tilde`) with the affine engine
1149	`isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ`. It is the Route-F endpoint for the
1150	globally-presented case; the general quasi-coherent case additionally requires producing a global
1151	presentation/tilde identification from the (Mathlib-absent) affine `QCoh(Spec R) ≃ Mod R` bridge.
1152	Project-local. -/
1153	theorem isLocalizedModule_basicOpen_of_presentation {R : CommRingCat.{u}}
1154	    (M : (Spec R).Modules) (_P : M.Presentation) (f : R) :
1155	    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
1156	      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
1157	        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom := by
1158	  haveI : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_presentation M _P
1159	  exact isLocalizedModule_restrict_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ M f

1439	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X)

/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — annihilator ideal sheaf and schematic support

These declarations build the annihilator ideal sheaf of a sheaf of modules and the
support/properness predicates of `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`,
§"Support and freeness predicates". Mathlib (at the pinned commit) carries no
annihilator ideal sheaf for sheaves of modules on a scheme, nor a schematic-support
or proper-support predicate, so they are built here.

The annihilator is packaged via `Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals`, exactly mirroring
Mathlib's `Scheme.Hom.ker` (which is `ofIdeals fun U ↦ RingHom.ker (f.app U).hom`):
`ofIdeals` produces *the largest ideal sheaf contained in* an arbitrary affine-local
family of ideals, so the structure's `map_ideal_basicOpen` coherence is discharged
internally and need not be supplied at definition time. The basic-open coherence that
makes the local annihilators agree with `ofIdeals` (the analogue of `Hom.ker_apply`,
`def:modules_annihilator`) is the separate characterization lemma `annihilator_ideal`,
which depends on the not-yet-closed QCoh→localization bridge
`isLocalizedModule_basicOpen` (`lem:qcoh_section_localization_basicOpen`) together with
the algebra engine `Module.annihilator_isLocalizedModule_eq_map`
(`lem:annihilator_localization_eq_map`); see the handoff in
`task_results/.../QuotScheme.md`. -/

namespace Scheme.Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The **annihilator ideal sheaf** of a sheaf of modules `F` on a scheme `X`
(`def:modules_annihilator`).

On each affine open `U`, the intended section is the annihilator
`Ann_{Γ(X,U)}(Γ(F,U))` of the `Γ(X,U)`-module of sections `Γ(F,U)`. The ideal sheaf
is assembled with `Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals`, the largest ideal sheaf contained
in that affine-local family — exactly the construction used for `Scheme.Hom.ker`. This
sidesteps proving the basic-open coherence (`map_ideal_basicOpen`) at definition time;
the identity `(annihilator F).ideal U = Ann_{Γ(X,U)}(Γ(F,U))` is the downstream
characterization lemma (`annihilator_ideal`, blocked on the QCoh localization bridge).

This is a project-local primitive: Mathlib does not carry an annihilator ideal sheaf
for sheaves of modules on a scheme. -/
noncomputable def annihilator (F : X.Modules) : X.IdealSheafData :=
  IdealSheafData.ofIdeals fun U => Module.annihilator Γ(X, U.1) Γ(F, U.1)

/-- The component of the annihilator ideal sheaf at an affine open is contained in the
module annihilator of the sections. This is the always-available (`ofIdeals`) direction
of the characterization; the reverse inclusion is the basic-open coherence blocked on
`isLocalizedModule_basicOpen`. Project-local because `annihilator` is. -/
lemma annihilator_ideal_le (F : X.Modules) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (annihilator F).ideal U ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, U.1) Γ(F, U.1) :=
  IdealSheafData.ideal_ofIdeals_le _ _

/-- The **schematic support** of a sheaf of modules `F` on a scheme `X`
(`def:schematic_support`): the closed subscheme of `X` cut out by the annihilator
ideal sheaf `annihilator F`. Project-local because `annihilator` is. -/
noncomputable def schematicSupport (F : X.Modules) : Scheme.{u} :=
  (annihilator F).subscheme

/-- The canonical closed immersion of the schematic support into the ambient scheme,
realizing `schematicSupport F` as a closed subscheme of `X` (`def:schematic_support`).
This is the `IdealSheafData.subschemeι` of the annihilator ideal sheaf; it is a
`IsPreimmersion` + `QuasiCompact` immersion onto the support. Project-local because
`annihilator` is. -/
noncomputable def schematicSupportι (F : X.Modules) : schematicSupport F ⟶ X :=
  (annihilator F).subschemeι

/-- The sheaf of modules `F` **has proper support over `S` along `f`**
(`def:has_proper_support`): the composite of the schematic-support immersion with
`f : X ⟶ S` is a proper morphism. Since `AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper` is stable under
base change, this condition is preserved by pullback, as required by the Quot functor's
pullback action. Project-local because `schematicSupport` is. -/
def HasProperSupport {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) : Prop :=
  IsProper (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)

end Scheme.Modules

end AlgebraicGeometry

892	
893	This section builds, bottom-up, toward the keystone
894	`lem:qcoh_section_localization_basicOpen`: for a quasi-coherent sheaf of modules `M`
895	on a scheme `X`, an affine open `U`, and `f ∈ Γ(X,U)`, the restriction
896	`M(U) → M(D(f))` exhibits `M(D(f))` as `IsLocalizedModule (powers f)` over `Γ(X,U)`.
897	
898	The substance is the affine (Spec-local) computation: over `Spec R`, a quasi-coherent
899	sheaf is `Ñ = tilde N` for `N = Γ(M)`, and the basic-open restriction of `Ñ` is the
900	module localization map. Mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.tilde` namespace already carries
901	the localization fact for `tilde N` *as the map out of `N`* (the instance
902	`IsLocalizedModule (.powers f) (tilde.toOpen N (basicOpen f)).hom`). The first building
903	block below repackages this as a statement about the *presheaf restriction map* of `Ñ`

4385	
4386	\leanok
4387	[Quasi-coherent module on an affine open is \texttt{tilde} of its sections (Stacks 01I8)]

4392	  (a quasi-coherent module on an affine scheme is \(\widetilde M\) for
4393	  some module).}

4395	  \(\mathcal O_X\)-module, and \(V \subset X\) an affine open. Then the
4396	  pullback of \(\mathcal N\) along \texttt{hV.fromSpec} is canonically
4397	  isomorphic to \texttt{tilde} of its sections:
4398	  \[
4399	    (\mathtt{Scheme.Modules.pullback}\,\mathtt{hV.fromSpec}).\mathrm{obj}\,
4400	      \mathcal N
4401	    \;\cong\;
4402	    \widetilde{\,\Gamma(\mathcal N, V)\,}
4403	    \quad\text{(on \(\mathrm{Spec}\,\Gamma(X, V)\)).}
4404	  \]
4405	  Mathlib \texttt{b80f227} ships the analog for \emph{free}
4406	  quasi-coherent modules (\texttt{isIso\_fromTildeΓ\_of\_presentation}
4407	  partial), but the general statement
4408	  ``\([N.IsQuasicoherent] \Rightarrow N|_V \cong \widetilde{\Gamma(N,V)}\)
4409	  on an affine open \(V\)'' (Stacks 01I8 \emph{lemma-affine-qc-module-iff})
4410	  is unowned at the \texttt{Scheme.Modules} layer.
4411	\end{lemma}
4412	\begin{proof}
4413	  \leanok
4414	  \uses{def:quot_canonical_basechange_map, lem:modules_pullback_mathlib,
4415	    lem:modules_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_mathlib}
4416	  Write \(j = \mathtt{hV.fromSpec} : \Spec\Gamma(X,V) \to X\) (an open
4417	  immersion with image \(V\)) and \(G = j^{*}\mathcal N\). Pullback along an
4418	  open immersion preserves quasi-coherence
4419	  (Lean \texttt{isQuasicoherent\_pullback\_fromSpec}), so \(G\) is a
4420	  quasi-coherent module on the affine scheme \(\Spec\Gamma(X,V)\); by the
4421	  affine structure theorem (Stacks 01I8, Lean
4422	  \texttt{isIso\_fromTildeΓ\_of\_isQuasicoherent}) the tilde--\(\Gamma\)
4423	  counit \(\widetilde{\Gamma(G,\top)} \to G\) is an isomorphism.
4424	
4425	  The canonical base map \(b : \Gamma(\mathcal N, V) \to \Gamma(G, \top)\)
4426	  (the \(V\)-sections of the pullback--pushforward adjunction unit followed by
4427	  restriction along \(\top \le j^{-1}V\)) is bijective. Indeed the two
4428	  adjunctions \(\mathrm{restrict} \dashv j_{*}\) and \(j^{*} \dashv j_{*}\)
4429	  share the right adjoint, so their units are identified through the canonical
4430	  natural isomorphism \(\mathrm{restrict} \cong j^{*}\)
4431	  (\cref{lem:modules_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_mathlib}). Under this
4432	  identification, the \(V\)-component of the unit of the restriction
4433	  adjunction is the presheaf restriction of \(\mathcal N\) along the
4434	  \emph{equality} of opens \(j(j^{-1}V) = V\), hence bijective; the component
4435	  of the natural isomorphism is bijective; and the final restriction is along
4436	  the equality \(\top = j^{-1}V\). Thus \(b\) is a composite of three
4437	  bijections.

4439	  Since \(b\) is a bijective \(\Gamma(X,V)\)-linear map (the
4440	  \(\Gamma(X,V)\)-action on \(\Gamma(G,\top)\) being through the canonical
4441	  ring isomorphism \(\Gamma(X,V) \cong \Gamma(\Spec\Gamma(X,V),\top)\)),
4442	  it induces an isomorphism
4443	  \(\widetilde{b} : \widetilde{\Gamma(\mathcal N,V)} \cong
4444	  \widetilde{\Gamma(G,\top)}\). The required isomorphism is the inverse of
4445	  \(\widetilde{b}\) followed by the counit. The characterizing section
4446	  identity holds because \(\widetilde{(-)}\)-functoriality intertwines the
4447	  canonical maps \(M \to \Gamma(\widetilde M, U)\) (naturality of
4448	  \texttt{toOpen}), while the counit composed with \(\mathtt{toOpen}\) at
4449	  \(\top\) is the identity restriction.
